bankito® frozen card

Motion·by @tyka_dominik·2026-09-02·inspora page·original post

What it is

iPhone banking app showing a frozen debit card: the card face is encased in an animated ice/frost texture with falling snow particles drifting across the screen; FROZEN badge, action rows below; ambient loop.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-100%
Dark app screen 'Debit card' with a frosted card visual: cracked-ice texture, blue-white frost creeping at edges, 'FROZEN' pill badge bottom-right, masked number *7481. Snow particles fall continuously at varying sizes/speeds, some blurred (depth). Below: Change limits / Reactivate card / Transactions icon rows. The loop is purely ambient - particles + subtle frost shimmer, no state change.

Build prompt

Build a frozen-card ambient scene. Dark banking screen; center a card (85.6x53.98 ratio) with an ice texture: base dark blue gradient, procedural crack lines (thin white strokes with branching), frost bloom creeping from corners (radial white noise, 60% opacity), plus a blue-tinted glass overlay. Badge 'FROZEN' pill bottom-right with snowflake icon. Snow: 40-80 particles on canvas, each with random radius 1-3px, fall speed 30-80px/s, horizontal sine drift (amplitude 10-30px, period 2-4s), opacity 0.3-0.9; 20% of particles rendered with 2-4px blur for depth; recycle at edges. Add a slow frost shimmer: a large soft white radial gradient sweeping across the card every ~7s at 8% opacity. Nothing else moves - the stillness sells frozen.
